method: Zhu-inspired proximity association; greedy one-to-one links ordered by endpoint distance and then time gap.

definitions.gates: Strict upper bounds on elapsed time and smoothed XY endpoint distance.
definitions.rejoined: The two fragments of a benchmark gap occur in the same output chain; the chain can contain other wrong links.
definitions.wrong_links: Links between different ground-truth vehicle identities across the full candidate pool, not only the 111 benchmark gaps.
definitions.unscorable: At least one endpoint lacks a supported ground-truth identity; excluded from correct/wrong link counts.

provenance.execution: Existing archived sweep; no new run for the website. Its script checks both 5 m rows against all 111 published pair outcomes and checks the coarse sweep links against the baseline implementation.
